contextId.occurrenceNote: This was a common greeting Paul used. He is leaving out some of the words that in many languages a sentence would need in order to be complete. You could supply these words if it would be clearer in your language. Alternate translation: [May you experience grace and peace]
«Fe» es un sustantivo abstracto. Si su idioma no usa sustantivos abstractos, puede expresar la idea de otra manera.

decisions.comments: Verificar si «fe» comunica bien el sustantivo abstracto en este contexto.
